title: The record of an item
description: The record that `bl list` gives for an item and that CEL runs over (commands.md D-437, core.md "Records and CEL"). `next/config/cel.js` derives the CEL types from it (F-136 D6). `status`, `run` and `counters` refer to `state.schema.json`, so the fields have one list (F-136 A2, D-483). F-148's record builder (`next/store/record.js`) builds the fields of its Decision A1. `findings` and `deferred` (F-142) and `gates` (F-150) are not required until the story that builds each one; `depth` (F-150) and `closed` (F-139) are set only where they apply. `run` also takes the `interrupted: <box>` that bl reads (F-139).

unit.description: The id of the item's work unit; for a work unit, its own id; null for an item whose type is not a work type (F-148 A1).

run.description: The run state as bl reads it: the stored run state, or `interrupted: <box>` for a stored `active: <box>` of this host whose item lock no process holds (D-50; F-139 Decision A5, `engineRecord`).

attribute_list.description: The attributes in the order of the item definition (D-438).

parents.description: The item's containment entry: slot name to id, or to a list of ids for a slot whose max is above 1 (D-604, F-148 A1).

rank.description: The 1-based place of the item in the rank chain; null when the chain does not hold it.

change.description: The text of the change.md of the item's work unit; empty when the item has no work unit or the file is not there.

depth.description: The depth in the tree, with --tree.

closed.description: True when the status is terminal for the item's type (statuses.md D-65); the engine sets it on each record that conditions read (F-139 Decision A5, `engineRecord`).

Finding.description: A review finding, the same record as `bl findings` gives.

Deferred.description: A bullet of the Deferred section.

Gate.description: A failing gate entry: `entry` as the configuration writes it (a CEL string or an object `{condition, class}`), `text` the expression as written.
